messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (federal holidays that create a three‑day weekend).  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “observed” day is usually the following Monday, which extends the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Mon | Jan 1–3 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Mon | Feb 20–22 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | May 22–24 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Sat | Jul 1–3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Sep 4–6 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | Oct 9–11 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Sat | Nov 11–13 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Dec 25–27 |

**Note:**  
- **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) is a federal holiday but falls on a Tuesday in 2023, so it does not create a long weekend.  
- Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island) that may also create long weekends locally.  

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app!
